info.title: Notary local administration API
info.description: Loopback administration API. Routes are available without credentials by default; configure admin.auth to require HTTP Basic authentication.

get.description: Returns the local service health and API version without requiring authentication.
Returns the exact OpenAPI 3.1 contract implemented by this local service.
Runs bounded metadata, selected artifact-writer, and shared trust dependency probes. Dependency outages or schema mismatches make readiness fail while /healthz remains local liveness.
Reports whether this local service has an account connection used for hosted admission, credits, and sharing.

post.description: Starts browser approval for an account connection used for hosted admission, credits, and sharing. Browser approval is unavailable while the daemon uses an injected API key.

delete.description: Removes the local account credentials. Future hosted sessions use public access until a new browser approval is completed. Injected API keys must instead be revoked in the hosted dashboard.

204.description: Account disconnected; hosted sessions return to public access

get.description: Checks a pending Notary account approval after its required polling interval.

Lists bounded, redacted Trace and service activity with opaque history pagination and a separate high-water cursor for following new items. Prompts, responses, credentials, headers, vault material, and decrypted capture content are never included.

Returns a safe read-only projection of the locally pinned Registry or the explicitly configured self-hosted endpoint and key. Registry membership describes allowed protocol use and does not report endpoint health.
Returns the current state, milestone progress, and complete attempt history for one durable operation.
Returns only notaryd's explicit provider adapters, their pinned upstream hosts, client API styles, proxy base URLs, and configured readiness.

post.description: Exchanges configured HTTP Basic credentials for an HttpOnly browser session cookie. Returns without a cookie when admin authentication is disabled.

delete.description: Deletes the current browser session and expires its local cookie.

get.description: Returns the authoritative daemon-owned mode used when admitting new provider requests.

put.description: Durably changes how later provider requests are admitted. Enabling first initializes trusted notary state; a failure leaves capture off.

get.description: Returns listener addresses, bounded metadata and artifact-writer readiness, vault and Notary configuration, preview limits, and current Trace counts.
Lists continuing Trace records in stable newest-first order with opaque cursor pagination and exact state, operational-status, provider, model, streaming, and date filters.
Returns one continuing Trace with capture facts, current state and operational status, retained evidence facts, notarization attempt history, and its canonical share summary.
Returns the bounded manifest and canonical disclosed OpenTelemetry content from the retained package. It never returns the encrypted capture checkpoint or undisclosed request material.

post.description: Idempotently starts, resumes, or retries the Trace's one durable notarization operation and returns its technical polling location.

get.description: Returns the exact retained canonical .llmtrace bytes without conversion, regeneration, or transformation, with length and SHA-256 metadata and no-store caching.
Returns the current canonical share's safe access and progress state. Hosted intake and presigned upload URLs are never exposed.

put.summary: Create or update a Trace share
put.description: Idempotently creates, resumes, retries, or changes the Trace's one canonical share after local verification and disclosure-safety checks. The encrypted .llmcapture is never uploaded.

delete.description: Stops public access while retaining the canonical hosted identity for an explicit later resume.

post.description: Verifies the retained package evidence, disclosure, hashes, provider mapping, and canonical content against configured Notary trust.
Verifies exactly one bounded .llmtrace body against a request-scoped key override or configured Notary trust. The package is never imported, retained, indexed, or shared.

parameters.name: x-notary-trusted-notary-key
parameters.description: Optional request-scoped compressed SEC1 Notary verification key in hexadecimal

high_water_cursor.description: Snapshot cursor for polling events committed after this response.

active_key_id.description:
Selected active Registry key. Explicit configuration has no Registry
lifecycle selection and therefore leaves this field unset.

registry_source.description: Public URL from which the current pinned Registry generation came.

source.description:
`registry` for the locally pinned trust store or
`explicit_configuration` for a self-hosted endpoint and key.

phase.description:
Current milestone: queued, preparing, proving, signing, packaging,
complete, or unknown for an operation migrated from an older metadata.

oneOf.description: Concrete work counters while the private proof is being generated.

expires_in_days.description: Optional expiry measured from the current time. Zero clears expiry.

force.description: Accept only reviewed, unexplained high-entropy safety findings.

password.description:
A new password, or an empty string to remove it. This value is never
logged, returned, or persisted by notaryd.

reactivate.description:
Explicitly restore public access to a stopped canonical share. Access
settings can be edited without reactivating it when this is false.
